mapper.insert: insert into index_outbox(event_id, document_id, index_version, event_type, payload, status, retry_count) values(#{eventId}, #{documentId}, #{indexVersion}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: select * from index_outbox where status in ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= NOW()) order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update index_outbox set status = 'PUBLISHED', published_time = NOW(), next_retry_time = null, last_error = null where id = #{id} and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRYING')
update index_outbox set status = 'PROCESSING', update_time = NOW() where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 'PUBLISHED'
update index_outbox set status = 'INDEXED', next_retry_time = null, last_error = null, update_time = NOW() where event_id = #{eventId} and status != 'INDEXED'

update index_outbox set retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = case when retry_count + 1 >= 5 then 'FAILED' else 'RETRYING' end, next_retry_time = case when retry_count + 1 >= 5 then null else DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(POW(2, retry_count), 300) SECOND) end, last_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() where event_id = #{eventId} and status != 'INDEXED'

update index_outbox set retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = case when retry_count + 1 >= 5 then 'FAILED' else 'RETRYING' end, next_retry_time = case when retry_count + 1 >= 5 then null else NOW() end, last_error = 'consumer callback timeout', update_time = NOW() where status in ('PUBLISHED', 'PROCESSING') and published_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND)
